newsitem.title: USA: Japan to order Nissan Mutual operation halt --Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan to order Nissan Mutual operation halt --Jiji.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance is preparing to issue an order to halt operations at Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co, according to a report by Japanese newswire Jiji Press.
Nissan Mutual Life would be the first insurance company in Japan to get an order to halt operations since World War II.
The ministry is expected to announce the decision in a few days, Jiji said.
Mainichi newspaper issued a similar story on its newswire.
All insurance payments to clients of Nissan Mutual Life would be protected, according to Jiji. Those accounts would be transferred to major Japanese insurance companies, it said.
Jiji reported that the ministry and Nissan Mutual Life have held unofficial talks about the plan and reached an agreement.
